Engineering Analyst - Salt Lake City
Goldman Sachs
Division: Engineering | Program: 2027 Analyst Program

Who we are:
At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don't just make things - we make things possible. Engineering is at the heart of our business, building scalable software and systems that power trading, risk management and client platforms.

What you'll do:
- Design, build and test software in Java and Python as part of an agile team.
- Write clean code, take part in code reviews and improve our CI/CD pipelines.
- Work with distributed systems, APIs and cloud services on AWS.
- Debug production issues and collaborate with business partners to solve problems.

Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field by June 2027.
- Knowledge of data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills; ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Goldman Sachs is an equal employment/affirmative action employer.
